_doc: The OD9 lyrics library. Maps a title keyword ('match') to a lyrics .txt in this folder. The Song-of-the-Week picker (crons/sotw_picker.py) draws the Quartermaster's grounded read from the matched file's lyrics; no match -> reaction-only that week (never fabricated). 'match' is matched case-insensitively as a substring of the catalog track title. track_id/platform document the exact song so re-cycles stay unambiguous (matching uses the title, not track_id). See README.md.
